data.name: Rawdaan
data.gender_notes: Rawdaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rawdaan is derived from the Arabic word 'Rawdah' which refers to a garden or a meadow. In Islamic context, it is used to refer to the Garden of Paradise. The name Rawdaan carries the meaning “Garden of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rawdaan usually hope their child will grow to embody garden of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bearing the name Rawdaan implies being connected to the divine gardens of paradise, symbolizing peace, tranquility and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Rawdaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden of Paradise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rawdaan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: روضاًن
in_arabic.meaning: روضاًن تعني الجنة أو الفردوس في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: روضاًن هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'روضة' التي تعني الجنة أو الفردوس. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى مكان جميل ومرغوب فيه. ويرتبط هذا الاسم بالعديد من المعاني الروحية والثقافية في التقاليد الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: رَوضاًن
in_urdu.meaning: رَوضاًن یعنی جنت یا فردوس کا مطلب ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: رَوضاًن ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ 'روضة' سے مشتق ہے جس کا مطلب ہے جنت یا فردوس۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافتوں میں ایک خوبصورت اور مرغوب جگہ کی نشاندہی کرنے کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایات میں روحانی اور ثقافتی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रौज़ान
in_hindi.meaning: रौज़ान यानी जन्नत या फरदौस का अर्थ है
in_hindi.long_meaning: रौज़ान एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। यह 'रौज़ा' से व्युत्पन्न है जिसका अर्थ है जन्नत या फरदौस। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृतियों में एक सुंदर और वांछित स्थान को दर्शाने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: روضاًن
in_pashto.meaning: روضاًن د جنت یا فردوس معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: روضاًن یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا د 'روضة' څخه مشتق شوی دی چی د جنت یا فردوس معنی لري. دا نوم د ډیرو اسلامی کلتورونو کی د یو ښکلی او غوره ځای د ښودلو لپاره کارول کیږي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو کی د مذهبی او کلتور اهمیت لری.

in_english.name: Rawdaan
in_english.long_meaning: Rawdaan is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, derived from 'rawdah', meaning paradise or heavenly abode. This name holds significant spiritual and cultural connotations in Islamic tradition, symbolizing a beautiful and desired place. Etymologically linked to Quranic descriptions of Jannah (Paradise), the name Rawdaan reflects themes of serenity and divine reward.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rawdaan can evoke images of beauty, abundance, and peace. It is a beautiful and unique name for a child that can inspire dreams of a lush and prosperous future, much like the verdant gardens of paradise. In some cultures, it is also a symbol of the importance of nature and the natural world.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, the name Rawdaan is a reminder of the promise of Paradise that awaits believers who lead virtuous lives. It is a name that can inspire hope and faith, and serve as a reminder to strive towards righteousness and good deeds in this life. Throughout history, the idea of a garden or a paradise has been used as a metaphor for the spiritual realm and the afterlife in many religions and cultures. In Islam, the Gardens of Paradise are described as beautiful and verdant, filled with flowing rivers, lush gardens, and fruit-laden trees, providing a breathtaking and peaceful eternal abode for the truly righteous.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Rawdaan: Garden of Paradise. A name suggestive of the owner's belief in the attainment of eternal blessings and beauty in the hereafter, as symbolized by a lush, verdant garden.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rawdah is the name of a garden in heaven, mentioned in the Quran. The name Rawdaan carried significant weight in that era.
